classes.runtime: identity-free: no player name, character, role, outcome, control or variable text; eligible as a prerendered runtime movie with its poster and animated alternative, after Integration review
classes.review: for review only, never a runtime asset: synthetic fixture identities drawn in (board-v2 review fixtures; a runtime draws its own match from the frame functions), or a role reveal film (it draws a dealt role; a client draws it live), or a study with no approved mount (the EJECT display cut and its exterior: no covering EJECT stage is approved)
classes.stills: storyboard frames for the live-action studies (review only)
classes.audio: public cue mixes, procedurally synthesized; a runtime plays the cue sheet itself under the device sound setting
